project.name: Hospital Management System (PRN232)
project.description: A comprehensive hospital management system for managing patients, doctors, appointments, medical records, and lab tests using .NET 8 and SQL Server.

nodes.name: Database Schema
nodes.summary: SQL Server database schema for hospital management system including tables for roles, users, staff, doctors, patients, appointments, medical records, prescriptions, lab test services, and lab test appointments.

nodes.name: AppointmentLabTest Entity
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing a lab test request linked to an appointment. Contains appointment and service references, test date, results, status tracking, and notes.

nodes.name: LabTestService Entity
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing available lab test services with pricing, categorization, and active status tracking. Collections of appointment lab tests reference this service.

nodes.name: Appointment Service
nodes.summary: Business logic service for managing appointments including CRUD operations, status transitions (Pending→Confirmed→InProgress→Completed), validation, and DTO mapping.

nodes.name: Medical Record Service
nodes.summary: Service layer handling medical records and prescriptions with repository injection, async operations, and complex DTO mapping including related patient and doctor data.

nodes.name: Appointment DTOs
nodes.summary: Data transfer objects for appointments using C# records with validation attributes. Includes AppointmentDto, CreateAppointmentRequest, and UpdateAppointmentRequest.

nodes.name: Medical Record DTOs
nodes.summary: DTOs for medical records and prescriptions using C# record patterns with nested prescription collections.

nodes.name: Appointments API Controller
nodes.summary: RESTful API controller for appointment operations with authorization, error handling, and endpoints for CRUD, check-in, confirmation, and examination workflows.

nodes.name: Medical Records API Controller
nodes.summary: API controller for medical records and prescriptions with role-based authorization for doctors and admins.

nodes.name: Lab Test Repository Interface
nodes.summary: Repository interface contract for lab test data access including GetAll, GetById, GetByAppointmentId, Add, Update, and Delete operations.

nodes.name: AppointmentLabTest Class
nodes.summary: Entity class with properties for appointment reference, service reference, doctor reference, test date, results, status (Pending/Completed), notes, and creation timestamp.

nodes.name: LabTestService Class
nodes.summary: Entity class representing lab test service catalog with service name, description, price, category, active status, creation date, and collection of appointment lab tests.

nodes.name: AppointmentService Class
nodes.summary: Service class with dependency injection of repositories, async methods for CRUD operations, status transitions, appointment limit validation, and DTO mapping.

nodes.name: MedicalRecordService Class
nodes.summary: Service class handling medical record and prescription operations with repository injection and complex data mapping.

nodes.name: Lab Test Workflow
nodes.summary: Complete workflow for lab tests: Doctor requests test → Lab staff enters results → Patient views results. Involves AppointmentLabTest entity, status transitions, and role-based access.

nodes.name: Repository Pattern
nodes.summary: Data access abstraction pattern used throughout the project with interfaces defining contracts and implementations handling Entity Framework Core database operations.

nodes.name: Service Pattern
nodes.summary: Business logic abstraction with services depending on repositories, async/await for IO-bound operations, and DTO mapping for API responses.

nodes.name: LabTestServices Table
nodes.summary: Catalog table storing available lab test services with pricing, categorization, and active status. Seed data includes 7 lab test types (blood tests, glucose, liver function, kidney function, X-ray, ultrasound, ECG).

nodes.name: AppointmentLabTests Table
nodes.summary: Junction table linking appointments to lab test requests with status tracking, test date, results, and doctor assignment for tracking which doctor requested the test.

tour.title: Database Schema Overview
tour.description: Start by understanding the database structure. The hospital system uses SQL Server with tables for roles, users, staff, doctors, patients, appointments, medical records, prescriptions, and lab tests. Pay special attention to LabTestServices (catalog) and AppointmentLabTests (requests).

tour.title: Domain Entities - Lab Test Models
tour.description: Examine the domain layer entities that map to the database. LabTestService represents the test catalog, while AppointmentLabTest represents requests linked to appointments.

tour.title: Repository Pattern - Data Access
tour.description: Learn how data access is abstracted through the repository pattern. The IAppointmentLabTestRepository interface defines the contract for lab test data operations.

tour.title: Service Pattern - Business Logic
tour.description: Explore how business logic is organized in services. AppointmentService and MedicalRecordService show the service pattern with dependency injection, async operations, and DTO mapping.

tour.title: Data Transfer Objects - DTOs
tour.description: See how DTOs are structured using C# records. AppointmentDto and MedicalRecordDto show the pattern with validation attributes and separation of concerns.

tour.title: API Controllers - REST Endpoints
tour.description: Examine the API layer controllers that expose operations to clients. AppointmentsController and MedicalRecordsController show endpoint design, authorization, and error handling patterns.

tour.title: Lab Test Workflow
tour.description: Understand the complete lab test workflow: Doctor requests test → Lab staff processes → Patient views results. This workflow is orchestrated through the AppointmentLabTest entity and service layer.
